module.name: axm-framestate
module.purpose: Local deterministic frame-state video/animation machine with canonical project truth separated from bounded rendered expression.

capabilities.description: Sample FrameState integer/scalar/keyframe track state deterministically at one frame using the existing integer timeline sampler.

evidence.boundary: the sampler returns integer timeline state only; it does not render media, mutate canonical project state, choose creative direction, or grant execution authority

callable.notes: Existing pure deterministic sampler; callable declaration adds no new timeline behavior.

capabilities.description: FrameState canonical project/timeline state and bounded deterministic realization machinery.

evidence.boundary: the finer-grained FrameState capability map remains authoritative for scoped maturity and known gaps

entrypoints.purpose: inspect the current FrameState capability map

not_claimed: Monolith execution merely because this source descriptor exists
rendered media or visual quality from the integer timeline sampler
merge, CANON, install, network, or risk-acceptance authority from a callable descriptor
universal cross-runtime or cross-project correctness beyond exact exercised requests
